# polaris_namespace (Data Source)

Fetches a namespace of a Polaris catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_namespace" "sales" {
  catalog   = "lakehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]
}

output "sales_location" {
  value = data.polaris_namespace.sales.location
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path as an ordered list of levels, e.g. `["sales", "eu"]`.

### Read-Only

- `location` (String) Storage location of the namespace.
- `properties` (Map of String) Namespace properties, without `location`. An empty map when the namespace has none.
